messages.subject: RE: Saxena settlement agreement - our mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Osei,

Further to agreement on quantum, here is our mark-up of the settlement agreement (your v1, our v2 redline). The substantive changes are the ex gratia figure to £130,000 in clause 4.1, the legal-fee contribution to £750 in clause 11.2, and the addition of the outplacement benefit to the Schedule. The protected-disclosure carve-out in clause 7 is acceptable as drafted. Subject to those, we're content.

Olivia Marsh
